summary: coding completed dashboard-overview; 7 incomplete feature(s) remain
commands: for f in streak-computation today-toggle weekly-grid; do echo "$f:"; grep -E '"passes"|"status"' .aidd/features/$f/feature.json; done

for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3330)
  bcode=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3331/api/v1/health)
  if [ "$code" = "200" ] && [ "$bcode" = "200" ]; then echo "READY frontend:$code backend:$bcode (iter $i)"; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
echo "final frontend:$code backend:$bcode"
echo "--- habits API ---"
curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:3331/api/v1/habits

for h in seed-habit-morning-run seed-habit-read seed-habit-meditate seed-habit-water; do
  echo "== $h =="
  curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:3331/api/v1/habits/$h/checkins | tr ',' '\n' | grep '"date"'
  echo "-- stats --"
  curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:3331/api/v1/habits/$h/stats
  echo
done
agent-browser open http://localhost:3330/ 2>&1 | tail -5; sleep 2; agent-browser snapshot -c 2>&1 | head -80

agent-browser click @e14 2>&1 | tail -2; sleep 2
echo "=== after toggling Meditate done ==="
agent-browser snapshot -c 2>&1 | grep -E "done\"|of 4 done|Mark today|streak|day" | head -40

echo "=== streak text via eval ==="
agent-browser eval "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main li')).map(li => li.querySelector('h3').textContent + ' => ' + li.querySelector('p').textContent).join(' | ')" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== revert: unmark Meditate ==="
agent-browser click @e14 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 2
agent-browser snapshot -c 2>&1 | grep -E "of 4 done|Mark today" | head -12
echo "=== console errors ==="
agent-browser errors 2>&1 | tail -10

agent-browser screenshot D:/applications/habit-tracker/.aidd/tmp-dashboard.png 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== stopping servers I started ==="
bun run stop 2>&1 | tail -8
bun run format >/dev/null 2>&1; bun run smoke:qc 2>&1 | tail -8

git add .aidd/CHANGELOG.md .aidd/features/dashboard-overview/feature.json frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardHabitItem.tsx && git diff --staged --name-only && echo "=== committing ===" && git commit -m "feat(ui): build dashboard overview with progress, weekly grid, and toggles" -m "- Replace placeholder dashboard with today progress (done vs total), a 7-day grid aggregated across all habits, and per-habit quick toggles with current streaks" -m "- Share the check-in query cache with the list page so both views agree and toggling updates counts/grid/streaks live" -m "- Handle empty, loading, and error states; exclude archived habits via the non-archived list route" -m "- Verified end-to-end with agent-browser against seeded data (2 of 4 done; weekly 2,3,2,2,3,3,2; live toggle 2->3); smoke:qc passes clean" -m "- Marked feature dashboard-overview passes: true, status completed" 2>&1 | tail -8

commitsCreated.subject: feat(ui): build dashboard overview with progress, weekly grid, and toggles
